notes:
Mega-release shipping Section A (5 quick wins) + Section D (Discord OAuth + bot install) + the user-flagged updates-don't-re-trigger-setup fix. Sections B and C are queued for v1.0.22+.

### What's new

**Account-type badge replaces paper-mode toggle.** DEMO / LIVE is now sourced from MT5 itself — connect a demo MT5 account if you want a sandbox; the topbar tells you which one you're on. Click the badge to hide it under Profile → Privacy for screenshots.

**Sign in with Discord + Install TradingSupport bot.** Click "Continue with Discord" on the login screen, or open the Bridge tab and click "Install TradingSupport Bot" to drop the bot into your Discord server (read-only — View Channel + Read Message History only, no audit log). Bot OAuth credentials are baked into this signed build; no per-install setup.

**Smoother Telegram setup.** Onboarding step 2 has a 5-step my.telegram.org walkthrough with explicit anchor text and inline format validation — api_id must be a positive integer, api_hash must be exactly 32 lowercase hex characters. Bad pastes fail closed before they get encrypted into the DB.

**Bridge tab is now interactive.** Disconnected MT5 / Telegram / Discord rows show "Connect →" and open an inline modal — no more bouncing through Config tabs to fix a dropped connection.

**Custom modals replace browser confirm()/alert().** Every "Are you sure?" dialog now matches the dashboard aesthetic — no more dev-looking native popups across ~14 sites (Close All, BE All, Reset Challenge, Reset History, Delete Account, Manual Trades, etc.).

**English by default; we stop overwriting your language choice.** v1.0.18-v1.0.20 silently reverted any language pick on every dashboard load. v1.0.21 only auto-fills on true first launch and defaults to English.

### Updates never re-trigger setup

Versioned legal acceptance: a stored legal_version stamp means the consent gate only re-fires when we explicitly bump the version constant (counsel-reviewed GA copy, etc.) — not on every upgrade. Existing v1.0.16-v1.0.20 acceptances are grandfathered in; the v1.0.21 upgrade does NOT re-prompt anyone who's already consented.

### What's NOT in this release (honest scoping)

MT5 auto-detect (registry scan + accounts/ enumeration), the multi-platform broker refactor (BrokerExecutor abstraction + cTrader Open API + TradingView Cloudflare relay), and the Discord bot's runtime listener thread are all queued for v1.0.22+. The v1.0.21 build ships the OAuth + install plumbing that v1.0.22's listener will sit on top of.

### Honest disclosure

Discord and Google OAuth secrets are baked into the binary at build time and recoverable from it with hex tools. Acceptable for invite-only beta; v1.1.0 hardening switches both to PKCE (Desktop client, no secret) before public beta.
